Let $G$ be a cyclic group of order $2$ and $5$.
We want to find the number of subgroups of index $7$ in $G$.
The free product of the cyclic group of order $2$ and the cyclic group of order $5$ is
$$ \prod_{i=1}^5 (2i - 1) = 2 \prod_{i=1}^5 i - \prod_{i=1}^5 1 = 2 \cdot 1 \cdot 2 \cdot 3 \cdot 4 \cdot 5 - 5 = 2 \cdot 120 - 5 = 240 - 5 = 235. $$
